prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Choose “FUEL-OUT” as the categorization for the failed test.
3. Click the Linked Appliance section to add an appliance.
4. Select the testing tool that you used. (i.e., Combustion Analysis Software, Power Meter).
5. Record any concerns/note relevant information.
6. Attach relevant test results and files.
7. Click Save Entry (Do not ignore the enter icon).

## When using PHAZA software

a. Use the PHAZA Master file naming convention for all tests.
b. Attach the .txt and .json files to the corresponding test record

## When using a phasewriter

a. Take photo(s) of the resulting printed tests.
b. Attach the photos onto the corresponding inspection/test record.

## PHAZA Master File Naming Convention

Test category_Test Type_Appliance Model#_Serial #_Date

File Type

i
